title: Expand audit bundle with modeling-usability reports
description: Thaw scope #7. The audit bundle (docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/) currently reports source coverage / record counts / region ledger only. Add modeling-usability reports: typed-advancement coverage per class/level, choice-coverage report, table-link/reachability report, overlay-vs-pack parity report. These reports are part of the new re-freeze evidence, not just source-coverage evidence.
close_reason: Implemented audit-bundle modeling-usability reports: typed advancement coverage, choice coverage, table link/reachability, overlay-vs-pack parity, and full playable-model audit output. Verified with npm run verify:worktree and audit-bundle generation to /tmp.
